what: PRE-FIX control for the 2026-09-03 must-noun fix: the rule as shipped on 2026-09-02 (master d04f271c labels.py) replayed on the 2026-09-03 live bank dump, so the fixed rule's artifact (label-heuristic-audit-20260903.json) can be read as a same-dump before/after. Precision audit of the auto label heuristics (pseudolife_memory/memory/labels.py) against a bank dump; counts and hand verdicts only, no bank text.
method: Every fact hit of the AUDITED SUPERSET rule (strong deontic | rule framing | never/always/do-not imperative anywhere | attribute name in {rule,constraint,policy,requirement,invariant,discipline}; value <= 400 chars) was hand-labelled genuine-rule vs descriptive; the verdict file holds the sha1-12 keys of the genuine ones. Each variant is scored as the fraction of ITS hits judged genuine; shipped hits outside the audited set are reported as unaudited, never as genuine.
blast_radius_note: No backfill ships: existing rows stay NULL. These counts are what a hypothetical auto-labelling of the dumped bank WOULD pin.
